      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents evicted package transactions from being improperly treated as permanent policy rejections. As the author notes, while 'not a major issue', immediate trimming under mempool limits previously resulted in 'unneeded censorship of someone low-balling package feerates' until the next block."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P and tests p2p opportunistic 1p1c package relay behavior when handling peer reject filters",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes peer reject filter handling so an evicted parent transaction can be fetched and reconsidered with a subsequent higher-fee child. Reviewer mzumsande notes this issue 'could be encountered via p2p 1p1c', ensuring reliable relay liveness across peers."
    },
